display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ext defense: OAuth2+PKCE, RBAC/ABAC,
sliding rate limit/user, schema validation,
TLS1.3+HSTS. Protocol: JWT RS256/ES256,
refresh rotation, SHA-256 key hash, generic errors.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Int defense: mTLS short-lived certs,
service identity+ACL, per-service rate limit,
audit every call. Protocol: mTLS internal CA,
service mesh sidecar, Vault secrets.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Webhook defense: HMAC-SHA256 sig verify,
replay protection (timestamp+TTL), payload
idempotency. Protocol: per-customer key,
X-Event-ID dedup, payload hash in signature.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
External API (public internet)
Threat: credential stuffing, token theft, CSRF,
SSRF, enumeration, XSS

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Internal API (VPC)
Threat: insider attack, compromised service,
lateral movement

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Public webhook receiver
Threat: forged payloads, replay attacks, DoS

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 1: threat model? Who uses the API,
what data flows through it, compliance requirements

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Validate: Ext = DAST/SAST, quarterly threat review, SIEM,
bug bounty. Int = quarterly pentest, network segment review,
monthly access review, IR drill. Webhook = signature test,
replay test, tamper test, retry handling test
